blurb: Guests spend time fly fishing in the Great Lakes Region of Western New York, targeting species such as Steelhead, Salmon, Brown Trout, and Smallmouth Bass. The guide service offers walking and wading fishing experiences in tributaries of Lake Ontario and Lake Erie. Advanced streamer and big bug strategies for large fish are also available.

quotes.text: Scott's experience and knowledge of fly fishing and the local fisheries is superior and recognized by many professionals in the sport. Scott shares his love and passion for fly fishing with anyone willing to learn. The combination of patience, experience, knowledge, and an all around great guy is a recipes for success. I never fly fished before. Several years ago Scott showed me the way with his exceptional guiding experience and within an hour put me on fish and I caught one! I am hooked. Thanks Scott great job.

I have fished with Scott on several occasions. Being guided by Scott is a pleasure as he is a fun , competent and skilled big fish finder. He is intimately familiar with the Lake Erie and Ontario tributaries where those big steelhead and browns hang out. If you need to brush up on your streamer tactics to bag the big boys , Scott is an excellent teacher with great communication skills.

My brother and I went out with Scott under what many might consider sub-par winter conditions in the Rochester area. The most popular streams were blown and muddy. Scott was able to get us into fish in smaller, less well-known creeks and helped my brother get his first big lake-run brown. A guide of considerable knowledge, patience, and teaching ability. Would definitely recommend!

Ontario Fly Outfitters provided a fishing experience that covered a wide area of upstate NY depending on the conditions. Scott knows where the fish are and is fun to be with. He is very knowledgeable about the species and I love that he has worked on many preservation projects on the local waterways. I would highly recommend him.

I’ve fished with Scott many times and we have always caught fish. He’s taught me a lot of new techniques for the Lake Ontario browns in local tributaries. We have also become good friends from fishing with each other.
